questions: Sam bought a skipping rope and a bouncy ball. How much did he spend?

steps: READ — Underline the items the person bought.
SPOT — Check the units. Convert pence-only prices to £.
PLAN — Decide the operation. Spend / altogether = add.
SOLVE — Use the partition method, exchange if needed.
